title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 20: Sheba's revolt, Joab's killing of Amasa, and the wise woman of Abel.

questions.text: Who blew the trumpet and said, "We have no portion in David"?
questions.explanation: A wicked fellow named Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite, blew the trumpet and said it.

questions.text: What did David do with the ten concubines he had left to keep the house?
questions.explanation: He put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn't go in to them, and they lived in widowhood until death.

answers.text: He sent them away to their fathers
He gave them to Joab as servants
He had them all put to death
He put them in custody and provided for them

questions.text: Within how many days did the king tell Amasa to call the men of Judah together?
questions.explanation: The king said to Amasa, "Call me the men of Judah together within three days."

questions.text: David said Sheba would do them more harm than whom?
questions.explanation: David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did."

questions.text: Where did Amasa come to meet Joab's men?
questions.explanation: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them.

answers.text: At the great stone in Gibeon

questions.text: How did Joab take hold of Amasa to kiss him?
questions.explanation: Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

answers.text: By the shoulder with both hands
By the beard with his right hand
By the hand with his left hand
By the neck with his arm

questions.text: What did the man cast over Amasa after carrying him out of the highway?
questions.explanation: He carried Amasa out of the highway into the field and cast a garment over him.

questions.text: In which city did Joab and the people with him besiege Sheba?
questions.explanation: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah and cast up a mound against the city.

questions.text: What did the woman promise would be thrown to Joab over the wall?
questions.explanation: The woman said to Joab, "Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall."
Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder.
